subject: Private deployment commercial sprint — pricing, platform fee amortization & support tiers
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial details — next steps

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the earlier deck — Procurement wants a concise commercial summary we can take into our internal sprint this week. Two asks: 1) final pricing cadence for a 36-month pilot -> production path (including platform fee amortization options), and 2) what support tiers map to response times and when additional SRE on-call would kick in (costs for 24/7 vs business-hours).

We also need the SOW draft in PDF rather than a Google Doc for legal review — if you can attach. Target: internal approval by Dec 10 so we can sign in January.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Procurement, NovaMed Health

---
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial details — next steps

Daniel — thanks, understood. Attached: a PDF SOW draft and a pricing matrix (summary and detailed tab). High level summary in-line below to make your sprint easier.

Quick summary (pilot -> production, 36 months)
- Pilot (months 0–3): 30% platform fee discount, capped node commitment (equivalent to 8x A100). Support: Business-hours SRE + standard monitoring.
- Ramp (months 4–12): platform fee amortized over 12 months (we apply 60% of platform fee in year 1, 40% carried as credit across years 2–3).
- Production steady-state (months 13–36): full platform fee at standard rate; unit token pricing declines with committed capacity.

Support tiers (examples)
- Standard (included): Business-hours (M–F 9–5 local) SLA for critical incidents: 8 hour initial response.
- Premium: 24/7 on-call SRE with 2-hour critical response — +12% of platform fee.
- Enterprise+: Dedicated SRE retainer (block hours) + managed runbook — priced as fixed monthly retainer; details in matrix.

We included two amortization options in the matrix: time-based (12mo) and usage-based (credit vs consumption). We think time-based is simpler for procurement for the pilot.

Attachments: NovaMed_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, redwood_privdeploy_price_matrix.xlsx

Next step: Are you open to a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk procurement through the matrix? If so, I can include Marissa (commercial) and Olga (legal operations).

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Mateo: +1 (415) 555-0198

---
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: NovaMed response prep — pricing playbook suggestions

Mateo / Olga — copying Irene for legal on timing. Quick notes before the sync:

1) Discount posture: procurement will push for deeper platform fee credits across years 2–3. We should offer a structured concession: additional 5% discount if they commit to a 60% increase in node footprint by month 12 (clear milestone). Keeps us protected while providing them upside.

2) SRE retainer: convert Enterprise+ to a 3-tier block hours option (100/250/500 hrs) with defined RTO/RPO commitments. Price as a fixed monthly add-on — easier for procurement vs ad-hoc hourly.

3) Amortization: prefer time-based 12mo amortization in commercial terms, but include a usage-based fallback in the SOW appendix — legal to review.

4) Escalation path: add a clause that allows automatic fallbacks to hosted API with rate-limiting protections if on-prem capacity saturates; this reduces our operational risk during burst events.

Can Olga/Irene draft the short escalation blurb and the milestone clause? Mateo, I'll run the concession by product (quick check) and see if we can extend the pilot discount by one month if they sign EOQ.

—Marissa
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

---
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:25:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Internal: NovaMed response prep — pricing playbook suggestions

Marissa / Mateo — noted. Drafted two short legal bullets to include in SOW appendix:

1) Platform fee amortization language (time-based): "Customer pays an initial platform activation fee which Redwood will amortize over twelve (12) months as a credit applied against future platform fees. In the event of early termination within month 13–36, remaining amortized credit will be reconciled per section X (pro rata)."

2) Escrow / fallback to hosted API (operational safety): "If Customer self-hosted capacity is unavailable due to infrastructure failure or capacity saturation, Redwood may, with prior notice and subject to Customer authorization, route excess workload to Redwood hosted endpoints with mutually agreed throttling to protect PII and regulatory constraints. Any such fallback shall be billed at Redwood's hosted rates with credit applied for Customer platform fee already paid."

Irene: can you confirm the phrasing on pro rata reconciliation and any export-control language we should add for EU-regulated datasets? Also, is the fallback language okay from a compliance perspective?

—Olga
Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Private deployment commercial details — next steps

Daniel — thanks for the quick turn. We discussed internally and have an updated, procurement-friendly commercial package attached (SOW PDF + pricing matrix). Highlights below for your sprint packet: 

1) Commercial package highlights
- Pilot (0–3 months): 30% platform fee discount and capped node commitment. Optional one-month extension if signed before Dec 31.
- Year 1 amortization: platform fee amortized over 12 months (time-based), detailed reconciliation language in SOW appendix.
- Conditional concession: additional 5% platform-fee discount in years 2–3 if NovaMed increases committed capacity by >=60% within 12 months of pilot start (milestone-based).

2) Support & SRE options (pick one)
- Standard (included): Business-hours coverage, 8-hour critical response.
- Premium (+12% platform fee): 24/7 on-call with 2-hour critical response.
- Enterprise+ (retainer): block-hour options (100/250/500 hrs) priced as fixed monthly add-ons; includes playbook runbooks & quarterly DR tests.

3) Risk mitigations
- Fallback clause permits controlled routing to Redwood hosted endpoints if on-prem capacity saturates (explicit data protection controls & billing credit mechanics included).

4) Timeline & asks
- Please confirm: preferred support tier, whether you want the 12mo time-based amortization, and if NovaMed would consider the milestone-based capacity commitment for the additional discount.
- If procurement wants, we can set a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow (Dec 2) at 10am PST.

Attachments: NovaMed_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, redwood_privdeploy_price_matrix.xlsx

If this looks good, I'll ask Legal to prepare final SOW redlines for DocuSign — target signature window: Jan 4–15.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
